themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation, with outside counsel, after reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a Chinese intelligence effort; the board said it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised and backs Huang (Nvidia, Nov 8). House committee chairs asked Huang to a closed door briefing Nov 18; Nvidia reports Nov 17 (CNBC). NVDA traded near 176.45 premarket Nov 9, down about 5.5% from 186.64 (Yahoo, Massive).
themes.for_you: NVDA is 'Wait' on the dashboard; no trade or put before Nov 17. Watch whether the rest of the chain (TSM, AVGO, AMD) holds up: if it does, the problem is Nvidia's, not the AI build's.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: China's commerce ministry and customs extended the suspension of the October 2025 rare earth export measures, due to end Nov 10, to Jan 10, as part of a wider pause in trade countermeasures (Reuters via ThePrint, Business Standard, Nov 9). That includes the 0.1% foreign content rule (No. 61). The April 2025 licenses on seven medium and heavy rare earths stay in force.
themes.for_you: No action. The magnet supply cliff moves to Jan 10, so MP (rated Avoid) and USAR lose a near term tailwind. LMT stays 'Buy zone now'; one supply risk is pushed back.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: Bitcoin traded near $74,581 on Nov 9 (Yahoo), about 1% under Strategy's average cost of about $75,385 a coin on 840,447 coins as of mid August (KuCoin report of company figures; no newer official figure found). Strategy sold 6,948 coins from May to August to fund preferred dividends and buybacks (same report). MSTR closed 128.93 on Nov 6.
themes.for_you: No MSTR put: crypto is a falling group. No crypto trades until bitcoin gets back above about $76,000.

innovations.name: Consumer
innovations.what: Rotation recheck. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop met Oct 30 with FDA reviewers calling the benefit 'limited to no clinical benefit' (Healio); no vote count or decision was found. Hims reports Q3 tonight against its own $880 million to $900 million revenue guide. Oura has set no new IPO date since Sep 29. No stage moves: no new approvals or revenue data.
innovations.for_you: No action. HIMS is 'Accumulate on pullback' and just under its 26.32 to 29.28 zone on Nov 6 data: no put into tonight's report; recheck after the refresh.

countries.name: China
countries.what: On Nov 9 China's commerce ministry extended its export control waivers, including the October 2025 rare earth rules due to return Nov 10, to Jan 10, as part of a broader pause in trade countermeasures and tariffs (Reuters via ThePrint). Trump is expected to meet Xi at APEC in Shenzhen later this month.
countries.for_you: No action. The extension lowers near term supply risk for China exposed US names. No China puts before the APEC meeting.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Oil fell instead of jumping after the weekend strikes: Brent was $94.23 at 8:17am ET Nov 9, down $4.09 (4.2%), and WTI $87.26, down 3.9%, after Trump said on Sunday that fresh strikes were highly unlikely while talks go on (Reuters). Ships were still hit near Hormuz, and Morgan Stanley noted physical Brent trading below futures, a sign of weak demand.
countries.for_you: No energy setups and no energy puts. DAL is 'Accumulate on pullback' and above its zone; cheaper fuel helps it but there is nothing to buy yet. OXY reports today.
